topics.title: Chapter overview
topics.summary: HarborMetrics turns a bounded measurement file into a deterministic summary. Its release workflow builds the application, runs contract tests, stages an installation, records artifact hashes, and creates a distributable archive. This is a complete small application and a reproducible packaging exercise, not a claim that every operational or regulatory requirement of a real organization has been satisfied.

topics.title: 21.1.2 Producing Release Artifacts
topics.summary: A release artifact contains the files needed by its intended consumer, plus enough identity information to diagnose it. For a native executable, platform and runtime compatibility still matter even when the archive itself is portable as a ZIP file. Document how the binary was built and which external runtime dependencies remain.

steps:
  - run: cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
  - run: cmake --build build --parallel
  - run: ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
  - run: cmake --install build --prefix stage
  - run: tar -C stage -czf app-${GIT_SHA}.tar.gz .
  - run: sha256sum app-${GIT_SHA}.tar.gz > app-${GIT_SHA}.sha256

topics.title: 21.2.2 Verifying Measured Improvements
topics.summary: A candidate is acceptable only if its improvement survives representative inputs and does not violate resource, accuracy, compatibility, or maintainability requirements. Repeat measurements, inspect variance, and test the release configuration on the intended hardware. A local microbenchmark is not a service-level performance guarantee.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build, test, stage, hash, and archive the real application. No network access."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("destination",type=Path,help="new directory; existing paths are refused")
args=parser.parse_args()
out=args.destination.resolve()
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
source=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
build=out/"build"
stage=out/"stage"
commands=[
    ["cmake","-S",str(source),"-B",str(build),"-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release"],
    ["cmake","--build",str(build),"--config","Release","--parallel","2"],
    ["ctest","--test-dir",str(build),"-C","Release","--output-on-failure"],
    ["cmake","--install",str(build),"--config","Release","--prefix",str(stage)],
]
with (out/"release.log").open("w",encoding="utf-8") as log:
    for command in commands:
        log.write("COMMAND: "+repr(command)+"\n"); log.flush()
        subprocess.run(command,check=True,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
manifest={"application":"HarborMetrics","version":"0.1.0","platform":platform.platform(),"files":[]}
for path in sorted(stage.rglob("*")):
    if path.is_file():
        manifest["files"].append({"path":str(path.relative_to(stage)),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
(stage/"manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
archive=shutil.make_archive(str(out/"harbor-metrics-0.1.0"),"zip",stage)
print(archive)

for path in sorted(stage.rglob("*")):
    if path.is_file():
        manifest["files"].append({"path":str(path.relative_to(stage)),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
(stage/"manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
archive=shutil.make_archive(str(out/"harbor-metrics-0.1.0"),"zip",stage)
print(archive)
